content:
emma: FYI forwarding a DPA erasure request from a customer. They want all data tied to their org_id=acme-42 removed + a signed attestation for GDPR. Also asking whether our KMS/HSM rotations affect deleted objects and how to prove deletion. Ticket #12345

tony: Can you paste the exact customer identifiers (org_id, API keys, sample request IDs)? need to map events in audit logs.

emma: org_id=acme-42, primary key id starts with rk-abc. Customer included two example request ids: req_2026-03-12_9f3 and req_2026-02-28_c7b.

ton y: small typo on your name 😅 (tony)

ton y: ack. Repro checklist I'm going to run -- please follow and share outputs: 
1) Export audit slice: run our internal export job for org=acme-42 -> s3 path (internal)
2) Search the audit index for those request ids and the API key prefix
3) Verify S3 object delete markers (if lifecycle) and inventory snapshots
4) Query KMS for key metadata: `aws kms describe-key --key-id alias/redwood-org-<org>` (no secrets)
5) If key is HSM-backed, check HSM key handle rotation log and wrapping metadata.

marta: Quick note on scope: we treat Redwood as data processor per DPA. For inference requests we only store request/response logs and short-term cache. User-provided uploads (if any) are stored per customer settings. Our standard retention for logs is 30 days unless customer has custom retention.

emma: Customer insists on removal of any residual embeddings/kv cache tied to that org. Is there an automated path for that?

marta: For KV/cache we have a per-org eviction endpoint. Steps: `POST /internal/evict-cache {"org_id":"acme-42"}`. That triggers async KV purge and frontends drop references. For embeddings stored in index, we run a reindex job which removes doc ids. That job is what we should schedule and include in the attestation.

sam: From legal POV: confirm we can provide (a) deletion log (events showing delete calls), (b) audit export of objects removed, and (c) statement of subprocessors involved during that time window. We should reference the subprocessor registry URL and include hashes of exported manifests. Also note: KMS key schedule deletion on AWS has a minimum 7-day waiting period if we schedule key deletion; if they want immediate cryptographic unlinking we can rotate to a new key and revoke access to the old key, but physical deletion is delayed by provider constraints.

audit-bot: export_job started for ticket=12345 -> s3://redwood-internal-exports/acme-42/2026-03-17-12345.json :job_id=exp-77

ton y: I ran a quick audit query and found a delete event for req_2026-02-28_c7b with event_type=eraser.v1.delete, uid=op-09. snippet:
```
2026-03-17T14:02:36Z eraser.v1.delete org=acme-42 obj=embeddings/doc-511 status=accepted op=op-09
```

emma: Customer asked for CSV with timestamps + operator id + object ids. Can we generate that from the export?

ton y: Yes. The export job includes a flattened CSV option. I'll attach once the job completes. Also will include S3 object paths and delete markers.

marta: On KMS/HSM: if objects were encrypted with a customer-key-managed key (CMK) we can provide `describe-key` output and the key rotation/logs; for HSM (on-prem partner) we can show wrapping metadata but cannot post raw HSM logs publicly — legal will need to sign off on attestation wording.

sam: Agree. Draft attestation should state: scope (org_id + time window), what was removed (log + embeddings + caches), methods used (API deletes, cache eviction, reindex), and limitations (provider key deletion timelines, subprocessor list snapshot link). We should avoid exposing low level HSM logs.

emma: Customer also asked whether any subprocessor changed in the last 12 months that would have had access to their data. Where is the canonical snapshot?

sam: Use our subprocessor registry: https://internal.redwood.com/subprocessors (we'll export a timestamped snapshot and include hash). We'll confirm any onboarding dates in that window.

audit-bot: export_job completed: s3://redwood-internal-exports/acme-42/2026-03-17-12345.json gz (size 4.2MB). CSV available at same prefix with filename audit_manifest.csv.gz

ton y: attaching quick sample of the CSV rows (sanitized):
```
org,object_id,op,timestamp,operator
acme-42,embeddings/doc-511,delete,2026-03-17T14:02:36Z,op-09
acme-42,cache/kv-88,evict,2026-03-17T14:05:12Z,svc-evict
```

emma: I'll send the CSV + drafted attestation to the customer. @sam can you greenlight the wording? I will mark ticket #12345 as high priority.

sam: I'll review and add the subprocessor snapshot. Expect turnaround today.

emma: Thanks all — I'll update once customer acknowledges. :thumbsup:
